answer: An equivocation-proof bond stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 60 units, emits a signed pulse each epoch. A prism log splits claims into facets: two clashing signatures from one key prove it; anyone submitting the pair slashes the bond and cancels its nectar share. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 for a 40,000 pool: a losing attack. Honest agents pay once, keep their full nectar share. Rented keys backfire: the lender's bond burns.
